scenes.setting: 15 Minsk Street, Thursday morning: Detective Moriarty's first clients — old Madam Doris and her formally dressed grandson — hire him for 5 soli to find Brody the missing black cat
scenes.text_anchor: A rope was being tugged, causing the doorbell and the sound it made to constantly tinkle

scenes.setting: 58 Minsk Street: a covert cane divination points at the old cupboard — Brody darts out, and "Inference, my good man" seals the detective's first solved case
scenes.text_anchor: “Jurgen, Jurgen Cooper, a senior solicitor,” the young man replied.

scenes.setting: Back at 15 Minsk Street: the red-eyed boy from the metro chase — Ian — hires Moriarty over the disappearance of his former detective, Mr. Zreal Viktor Lee
scenes.text_anchor: “You can call me Ian,” the teenage boy surveyed his surroundings
